name: Record a speaking sample and request AI feedback
covers: structured strengths, improvement, drill, and rewrite feedback
description: Verifies a learner can record or provide a transcript and see useful coaching feedback or a clear retryable error.
steps: Record a short sample or enter a transcript
expected: Feedback with strengths, one improvement, and a next exercise appears, or a clear retryable error is shown.

name: Generate a personalized seven-day speaking plan
description: Verifies a learner can choose a goal, confidence level, and daily time budget, generate a plan, and revisit it.
steps: Choose a goal, level, and daily time
expected: A seven-day plan with day-by-day drills and reflections is shown and remains saved in the browser.

name: Practise an interactive real-life conversation
description: Verifies the learner can select a scenario, send a response, receive a contextual follow-up, and reset intentionally.
expected: A contextual roleplay reply appears, conversation turns persist locally, and confirmed reset clears the chat.

name: Sign in and sync private progress
covers: user-scoped cloud profile read and write
private coaching history backup and restore
description: Verifies an authenticated user can save practice progress to their own account and load it again.
steps: Sign in using the account dialog
Complete a daily task and add a custom word
Choose Sync now and reload the app
expected: The signed-in user's saved words, tasks, and challenges load from their account without exposing another user's data.

name: Complete a guided speaking challenge
description: Verifies a learner can open a prompt, practise it, and mark the challenge complete.
steps: Open Voice studio, return to the challenge, and mark it complete
expected: The challenge is marked complete and the challenge count increases.

name: Enable daily reminder and practice on mobile
description: Verifies reminder opt-in and practice interactions are usable on a narrow screen.
steps: Set a reminder time and enable notifications
Open a speaking challenge and mark it complete
expected: The reminder setting is saved, progress updates, and controls remain usable without horizontal overflow.

name: Reject empty AI coaching input and invalid custom words
description: Verifies empty requests and blank or duplicate words are rejected safely.
steps: Request AI feedback without audio or transcript
Try to add an existing word again
expected: Clear validation messages appear and no empty or duplicate word is added.
